module_summary: AXI4 slave RAM: independent write and read burst FSMs latch AXI address/length/size/burst, step addresses through a byte-strobed memory array, and return B responses and registered (optionally pipelined) R data.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: RAM array written by strobed wdata, read into rdata register

anchors.name: write_state_reg
anchors.why: Write FSM IDLE/BURST/RESP controlling awready, wready, memory write and bvalid

anchors.name: read_state_reg
anchors.why: Read FSM IDLE/BURST controlling arready, memory read and rvalid

anchors.name: write_addr_reg
anchors.why: Current write burst address, incremented per beat, addresses mem write

anchors.name: read_addr_reg
anchors.why: Current read burst address, incremented per beat, addresses mem read

anchors.name: write_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining write beats counter deciding burst end

anchors.name: read_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining read beats counter deciding rlast and burst end

anchors.name: write_burst_reg
anchors.why: Latched write burst type enabling address increment

anchors.name: read_burst_reg
anchors.why: Latched read burst type enabling address increment

anchors.name: write_size_reg
anchors.why: Latched write beat size setting address step

anchors.name: read_size_reg
anchors.why: Latched read beat size setting address step

anchors.name: write_id_reg
anchors.why: Latched AWID returned as BID

anchors.name: read_id_reg
anchors.why: Latched ARID returned as RID

anchors.name: mem_wr_en
anchors.why: Memory write enable on accepted write beat

anchors.name: mem_rd_en
anchors.why: Memory read enable loading rdata register

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Optional extra output pipeline stage for read data

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Valid of optional output pipeline stage, gates read issue

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write burst start address latched into write_addr_reg

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Write address valid starting write burst

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: Write address ready from write FSM

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data stored into mem

anchors.name: s_axi_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobes enabling per-byte memory writes

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Write data valid advancing write burst

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Write data ready from write FSM

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid issued at burst end

anchors.name: s_axi_bready
anchors.why: Write response ready clearing bvalid

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read burst start address latched into read_addr_reg

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Read address valid starting read burst

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: Read address ready from read FSM

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data from rdata register or pipeline register

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid from read path registers

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Read data ready allowing next beat and pipeline advance

anchors.name: s_axi_rlast
anchors.why: Last read beat marker from read count

groups.name: Write channel controller
groups.description: Write burst FSM with address/count/size/burst latches and B response generation

groups.name: Read channel controller
groups.description: Read burst FSM with address/count latches issuing registered R beats

groups.name: RAM array
groups.description: Byte-strobed memory with registered read data

groups.name: Read output pipeline
groups.description: Optional extra register stage on R channel when PIPELINE_OUTPUT set
